rule_0.statement: THE TOUCH-RESET LAW: a touch event that legitimately resets a stance clock must be a TOUCHDOWN, not a band-edge graze. THE DERIVATION (Rule 1 -- every number measured on the byte-exact baseline 481f9f56 on this lane BEFORE any edit, from a per-tick mining pass in gait_unit.cpp with the controller byte-untouched): the wave-21 death chain's arming event is the hind clock's own contact classification in update_clock -- a leg 'touches' when ANY of its foot points' gaps is <= kTouch = 1e-5 m, and the RISING EDGE of that band test resets phi to 0 (the contact-reset hybrid clock, derivation Section 5.1). The measured event profile separates the two touch classes by FOUR ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE on both signatures: (1) THE LEGITIMATE TOUCHDOWNS -- the L hind lands at gap-tick 40 (its pair-min gap descends from 1.579e-2 m at tick 34 at ~2.6e-3 m/tick; the FINAL tick closes 1.951e-3 -> 1.5e-10 m) and the R hind lands at gap-tick 55 (pair-min 1.210e-3 -> 7.0e-8 m in the final tick, from airborne 1.17e-1 m at reset): a genuine arrival crosses the ENTIRE band and a thousand times more of it within ONE tick, loaded on arrival (rxn 9.869 N at 55), descending. (2) THE GRAZE -- at tick 64 the loaded R hind (rxn 8.454 N, slip 0.4531 m/s, mid-arrest) pops ONE tick to a pair-min of 1.016e-5 m -- 1.6e-7 m above the band edge, 0.016 of the band's own width -- and is back in band at 65 (5.52e-7 m); the rising edge at 65 fires the clock's touch-reset during step 66: phR 0.52817 -> 0.00000, the phase-0 TD column commands against the leg's coherent mid-stance pose (hip target -5.317 -> +43.808 deg = a +47.49 deg step against the actual -3.68 deg; knee +22.3, ankle -29.5, MP -28.1), the capped servo plows the loaded sliding foot (slip 0.4386 -> 2.0298 m/s at 78 under rxn 15.8 -> 23.4 N, demand ~3-8x the friction cone), the trunk pitch reverses at 66 and the storm exhausts gait_impact_event_budget at 80. The graze's separation speed is 1.6e-7 m / (1/300 s) = 4.8e-5 m/s -- BELOW the solver's own plane-engagement velocity gate (gate = 1e-6 + 1e-3*joint_speed_scale >= 1e-3 m/s scale): by the machinery's OWN contact definition (rate()'s two-part test: gap <= kTouch AND inward speed <= gate) this foot NEVER left the contact; the band test alone is the defect. THE THREE CANDIDATES, each derived against the measured event: (a) THE RELEASE-HYSTERESIS DEBOUNCE [CHOSEN]: the clock's contact state releases only when the leg's pair-min gap exceeds kTouch by more than kStab = 1e-6 m -- the contact solver's OWN gap quantum, already in the machinery (the positional-correction penetration band -1e-6, the paw-band penetration bound -1e-6); the measured separation is decisive -- the graze's 1.6e-7 m excursion sits 6.25x BELOW the quantum (never releases -> never re-arms -> no reset), while a genuine touchdown arrives from departure depths of 6.5e-2/1.17e-1 m (the L/R pre-TD air) and closes 1.21e-3/1.95e-3 m in its final tick (1200-1950x ABOVE the quantum; any genuinely free foot crosses the whole margin in under 1% of a tick -- gravity alone moves a free foot g*dt^2 = 1.090e-4 m per tick, 109x the quantum); the law is TIMING-EXACT for real touchdowns (their release state cleared while genuinely airborne many ticks before arrival -- the rising edge fires on the SAME tick as the old band law; no delay, no added state, no blend); and it fixes the STATE (the clock keeps its coherent mid-stance phase -- every consumer of phi, the servo columns, the vault table, the arming law's swing-window clause, reads the truth). (b) THE POSE-COHERENT RESET [REJECTED, measured reasons]: it accepts the misclassification -- the clock IS reset to 0 at mid-stance -- and only limits how fast the servo pursues the wrong column; the derived trackable blend rate from the friction cone is mu*g horizontal = 5.88 m/s^2 on the ~0.4 m foot lever = 0.049 rad/tick ~ 2.8 deg/tick, so the measured +47.5 deg hip step blends over ~17 ticks -- ~17 ticks of dragging a 7-8 N loaded foot at the cone's edge: the SAME plow, rate-spread (the drag force is unchanged; only its application is smoothed), and the state error persists ~17 ticks into every phase consumer (the vault trunk target, the phase-offset report, the arming law's swing-window clause, the duty census). At legitimate touchdowns the blend is not free either: the pose step there is small but NONZERO (the swing-delivered pose lags the TD column by the tracking error), so an added rate law taxes every real TD's settle -- risking the fenced wave-20 named ticks. It patches ONE consumer of a corrupt state instead of the state. (c) THE GLOBAL BLEND-RATE LIMIT [REJECTED, measured/scope reasons]: (b)'s wrong-state flaw with the widest blast radius -- a global commanded-target bound re-times EVERY servo path from tick 0: the entry composition (press by tick 4, peak 41.3247 N at 31, capture at 60 -- the fenced wave-19/20 digits), the planted-strut IK tracking, the posture vault blend; the scope fences the entry/fore machinery byte-untouched, and a global rate bound touches them FIRST. The cone derivation that kills (b) kills (c)'s end-state equally. THE ONE MECHANISM is (a): ONE classification branch in update_clock (the clock machinery's event law), zero new free constants (kStab is the solver's existing gap quantum), the arming law and the entry/fore machinery byte-untouched.
